sources.adapter: DXGI IDXGIFactory1::EnumAdapters1 + GetDesc1 (software adapters skipped, largest DedicatedVideoMemory wins)
sources.utilization: \GPU Engine(*)\Utilization Percentage summed per engine type, busiest type, filtered by the adapter LUID
sources.memory: \GPU Adapter Memory(*)\Dedicated Usage and Shared Usage, filtered by the adapter LUID
sources.sharedLimit: GlobalMemoryStatusEx total physical memory / 2 (WDDM shared-memory convention)
sources.temperaturePowerFan: MSI Afterburner MAHM v2 read-only mapping, matched by VEN_/DEV_

notes: A 36 px top AppBar reservation from a separately running YASB instance was already present when the probe ran, so the recorded workArea values include that foreign reservation (top 36 on DISPLAY1, -1044 on DISPLAY2) and are not Strata reservations.
DXGI reports 8413773824 dedicated bytes for this 8 GiB card (driver-reserved VRAM excluded), so the popup reads 1.5 GiB / 7.8 GiB rather than Task Manager's nominal 8.0 GB.
The first history point carries a null percentage (PDH counter warm-up) while its temperature is already valid; per-metric independence is intentional.
